hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0002 = F(t)[t->x], G0003 = F(t)[t->y], G0001 = first Newton divided difference F[x,y] = (F(x)-F(y))/(x-y).
required_assumptions: f is a unary function symbol
x and y are distinct variables in the declared symbol set
the denominator x-y is nonzero wherever the expression is evaluated
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: The raw expression is the first Newton divided difference of the unary function f at nodes x and y; the remaining catalog entries are the node evaluations f(x) and f(y) that define the numerator.
